findings.observation: Exactly one coherent adult woman appears in a grounded three-quarter stance, with one head, two anatomically consistent arms and hands, and two anatomically consistent legs and feet; no duplicated body or anatomy is present.

The complete tousled auburn hair and head, both relaxed hands, the hanging seed case, every longcoat and underlayer hem, both trouser legs, and both fitted shoes remain fully visible inside safe parchment margins.

Visible broad brush texture, softly planar facial and cloth modeling, restrained edges, and a warm parchment wash establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing without photographic pores, lens treatment, plastic 3D, or cel-anime rendering.

Aean otherwise reads as a band-3 light-medium, healthy-slight-lanky, long-limbed 22-year-old with an angular diamond face, asymmetric brows with one notch, broad cheek planes, prominent bridge, compact closed mouth, auburn offset braids, ochre-cream tailored longcoat, high collar, split hems, plain underlayer, fitted shoes, and one polished hanging seed case. However, the sole tattoo is a conspicuous medium side-neck botanical motif rather than the declared one small nape tattoo, so the bounded personal anchor drifts in size and placement.
The compact closed mouth, direct level gaze, asymmetric restrained brows, leading shoulder, and relaxed hands read calm and neutral without smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

The overall cloth-and-seed-case presentation is grounded and contains no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, UI, logo, watermark, or text. However, clear four-point star emblems appear on the longcoat hem and a star/compass emblem appears on the seed case, violating the explicit no-printed-star constraint.

The output uses the authorized warm painterly register but establishes a distinct lighter, narrow angular face, tousled red-copper mixed braid-and-loose-hair construction, slim long-limbed body, tailored longcoat, seed case, brow notch, and tattoo. It does not reproduce the reference subject’s face, darker phenotype, muscular body, solid black undercut braid, wrap outfit, progression staging, or magical ornaments.
